cross_source_findings.finding: Brochure page 23 gives body width without mirrors as 1813 mm; the October 2026 price-list page-7 inventory records 1812 mm.
cross_source_findings.decision: Preserve both source-bound observations; do not overwrite or collapse the discrepancy.

cross_source_findings.finding: Brochure page 20 states Hybrid 155 battery voltage as 280 V; the later July 2026 price list records 200 V.
cross_source_findings.decision: Preserve both dated source observations; do not normalize the difference.

cross_source_findings.finding: The brochure page-20 maximum-payload values for ten configurations exactly match the 2026-07-03 official price-list ranges; four mild hybrid-G 140 configurations differ (452/521 kg versus 451/540 kg).
cross_source_findings.decision: Do not create ten duplicate brochure range records. Preserve the four existing 2025 brochure ranges and all fourteen later price-list ranges.

cross_source_findings.finding: The brochure uses Hybrid-G 150 4x4 naming while the October 2026 catalogue uses Tribrid 150 4x4 naming.
cross_source_findings.decision: Use explicit source/configuration relationships and dated naming reconciliation; do not rename or project historical observations by inference.

cross_source_findings.finding: Page 8 YouClip prose states five standard points plus two optional points while the page-22 matrix shows 4/5/5/5 by grade.
cross_source_findings.decision: Retain as an explicit source conflict; do not normalize one count without a scope resolution.

cross_source_findings.finding: The page-19 accessory page states the roof rack is incompatible with the panoramic glass roof.
cross_source_findings.decision: Record the exact incompatibility in the accessory compatibility row without changing grade-level compatibility states.

cross_source_findings.finding: The page-14 colour palette marks five colours as available in two-tone; Czarna Perła has no two-tone marker.
cross_source_findings.decision: Record the palette and exact printed markers at model level. Do not infer grade applicability or treat an unmarked colour as explicitly unavailable for two-tone.

cross_source_findings.finding: The page-20 cargo table and page-21 equipment matrix conflict on the Hybrid-G 150 4x4 repair-kit context.
cross_source_findings.decision: Keep the Hybrid-G 150 4x4 cargo values deferred; do not project repair-kit/spare-wheel states.

master_reconciliation.colour_palette_scope: Six model-level palette items; no configuration mapping because page 14 does not state grade applicability and page 24 contains a general grade-availability caveat.
master_reconciliation.payload_scope: Four 2025 brochure ranges remain source-bound; ten other values exactly match the 2026-07-03 cennik and were not duplicated.
